alert_sensitivity.title: Alert sensitivity
alert_sensitivity.page_description: Choose when outages trigger an alert.
alert_sensitivity.intro: How long a site must be down before Heptapod sends an alert.
alert_sensitivity.site_intro: Overrides the team default for this site only.
alert_sensitivity.site_description: Use the team default or choose alert timing for this site.
alert_sensitivity.preset.strict.label: Strict
alert_sensitivity.preset.balanced.label: Balanced
alert_sensitivity.preset.relaxed.label: Relaxed
alert_sensitivity.preset.patient.label: Patient
alert_sensitivity.preset.strict.conseque: You hear about every interruption of 2 min or more. Recovery is reported at once.
alert_sensitivity.preset.balanced.conseq: You hear about outages after ~5 min. Short interruptions under 5 min stay quiet.
alert_sensitivity.preset.relaxed.consequ: You hear about outages after ~10 min. Short interruptions under 10 min stay quiet.
alert_sensitivity.preset.patient.consequ: You hear about outages after ~30 min. For staging and low-priority sites.
alert_sensitivity.existing_custom: This saved timing is outside the :min–:max minute range. You can keep it unchanged.
alert_sensitivity.existing_custom.detail: To change the minutes, enter a value from :min to :max.
alert_sensitivity.custom_consequence: Choose how many failed minutes to wait and how many good checks confirm recovery.
alert_sensitivity.recovery_confirmed_one: Recovery is confirmed after :count good check.
alert_sensitivity.recovery_confirmed_oth: Recovery is confirmed after :count good checks.
alert_sensitivity.footer: Applies to uptime only, and to new interruptions. The incident list, the uptime bars and the Down count stay complete.
alert_sensitivity.inherit_description: Use the timing from Settings · Routing, including future changes.
alert_sensitivity.preview_assumption: Example: one check per minute; an incident opens after :checks failed checks. Each square is one check.
alert_sensitivity.preview_quiet: No alert. It stays in the incident list.
alert_sensitivity.preview_alert: Down alert at minute :minutes. Recovered at minute :recovery.
alert_sensitivity.import_summary: Alert timing: team default — :inherited; Oh Dear value retained — :overridden.
notifications.suppression.recovered_with: Recovered within the alert delay. No opening alert was sent.
notifications.suppression.episode_alread: An opening alert was already sent for this interruption.
notifications.suppression.episode_contin: The interruption continued; its next incident carries the opening alert.
notifications.suppression.reopened_befor: The interruption returned before recovery was confirmed. No recovery alert was sent.
notifications.recovery_checks_pending: Waiting for consecutive good checks before sending recovery.
notifications.maintenance_ended_context: Maintenance has ended. This interruption is still ongoing.
notifications.suppression.superseded_by_: Replaced by the first post-maintenance alert for this interruption.
notifications.deferred_by_maintenance: Waiting until muted maintenance ends at :time.
notifications.deferred_by_snooze: Waiting until the snooze ends at :time.
notifications.preview_alert_delay: Waiting for the saved alert deadline
notifications.preview_opening_suppressed: This opening alert will not be sent.
notifications.preview_opening_muted: Alerts are muted by snooze or maintenance.
notifications.opening_snoozed_no_catch_u: Alerts for this outage were snoozed. No opening alert is sent after the snooze ends.
notifications.preview_maintenance_catch_: This outage opened during maintenance. Catch-up alerts and reminders are off.
alert_sensitivity.intro_detail: Status, incidents and uptime still show every failed check.
